messages:
katie: Quick sync 'bout marketplace onboarding — we need all artifacts for AWS/GCP/Azure by EOD. Legal, AMI/container IDs, SKU list, and support alias. Status?
raj: Legal uploaded draft reseller agreement + privacy addendum to drive. Waiting on SOC2 evidence from infra. Also need approved EU residency sentence.
marco: Pricing draft ready (dev/std/pro/ded). Need product to confirm trial length and trial caps so I can generate SKUs.
sara: Ingest: created manifest template and staging prefixes. Use `redwood-marketplace/ingest/<provider>/<ticket>/manifest.json`.
alex: FYI I hit permission error on the Azure blob this morning 'til I added contributor role to the publisher service principal. All good now.
jen: Docs/support: confirm support alias. I will draft onboarding runbook once we have final SKUs and manifest link.
raj: Support alias: marketplace-support@redwood.ai. SOC2 ETA: tomorrow morning. EU residency wording suggested: "data processed in specified EU regions only" — ok?
katie: That wording is fine. Marco please set trial to 14 days per product.
marco: 14-day trial accepted. Propose trial caps: 2k requests/hr and 3 concurrent sessions. Updating SKUs now.
sara: Manifest sample below — include `artifact_ids`, `image_urls`, `support_email`, `trial_days`, and `pricing_skus`.
sara: ```
{
  "provider":"AWS|GCP|Azure",
  "name":"Redwood Inference",
  "artifact_ids":["ami-0abc","gcr.io/redwood/infer:1.2.0","azure:cont:9876"],
  "image_urls":["https://assets.redwood.ai/logo-256.png"],
  "pricing_skus":["DEV-1","STD-1","PRO-1","DED-1"],
  "support_email":"marketplace-support@redwood.ai",
  "trial_days":"14"
}
```
ops-bot: Task created marketplace/onboard/1812400000 — checklist: legal artifacts, manifest upload, SKU confirmation, runbook link. Assignee: partnerships-katie.
katie: Plan: Raj follows SOC2, Marco finalizes SKUs, Jen prepares runbook, Sara validates manifests after upload. Aim to request publisher review by EOD.
raj: Chasing infra and legal now; will post SOC2 when available.
marco: SKUs updated and pushed to pricing doc. I'll attach final manifest entries shortly.
jen: Runbook scaffold posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/marketplace/1812400000
sara: Running manifest validation against staging. Please prefix artifact filenames with ticket id `1812400000_` for traceability.
katie: Thanks all — ping here if anything blocking. :thumbsup:
